bug_fixed.symptom: Every generated Apply failed with: The target slide no longer exists. Create and review a new outline before Apply.
bug_fixed.root_cause: Real PowerPoint hosts return slide ids that already contain '#' (observed id: 256#3520995159). The add-in appended a '#' delimiter to the reviewed target id and then stripped from the first '#', producing '256' which never matched the host id.
bug_fixed.fix: Keep the host slide id verbatim, compare stringified ids, and stamp footers with stringified id comparison. The mock host now mirrors composite ids and no longer strips at '#'.
bug_fixed.regression_tests: node --test powerpoint-addin/taskpane.test.js -> 21/21 pass (includes composite-id and numeric-id cases)

honest_notes: This evidence proves the add-in integration, guards, template insertion and provenance on real PowerPoint Desktop; it does not prove content quality.
The edit-mode proposal was written in the pane and applied once; a later proposal used only for the provenance screenshot was not applied.
The second generate outline (after the deck had 4 slides) was created only to capture provenance and was not applied; the saved deck remains 4 slides.
The synthetic account password, session token and provider key are not stored in this folder.
